name: TeamStarWolf - Stryker Device-Wipe Attack March 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the Stryker device-wipe case study, from the persona domains Iran's MOIS used to claim the 11 March 2026 attack through the compromised cloud administrator path to the remote wipe of managed devices. Score 100: a primary opened for the study describes the behavior. Score 60: the tie rests on ATT&CK's G1055 VOID MANTICORE rows or is a partial, persona-level fit. Score 40: Reported sources only. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. Each technique appears under every tactic ATT&CK gives it. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
